connector.name: PH Civic Data
connector.registryDescription: PH civic data + auto-stitched area profiles (PSGC, PSA economy, infra, hazards). 29 tools.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package ph-civic-data-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the xmpuspus account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PAGASA_API_TOKEN
env.description: Optional PAGASA TenDay API token. Without it, get_weather_forecast automatically falls back to Open-Meteo.
